contract_answer.question: Does replacing the adaptive gate MLP with a constant g=0.12 worsen the GateRepair parent enough across the three paper splits to credit the adaptive gate?
contract_answer.conclusion: Independent recomputation from the 600 selected-checkpoint predictions (epoch 7) gives split-2021 MAPE 0.104607, Acc@15 0.6867, RMSE 23.935 cycles, bias -18.258, prediction/target std 13.11/20.28, versus NA-E009 MAPE 0.099874, Acc@15 0.7433, RMSE 22.528, bias -15.908, std 15.21/20.28 (delta MAPE +0.004733). Prefix bands (ablation vs parent): 01-10 0.1102 vs 0.1221; 11-25 0.0993 vs 0.0936; 26-50 0.0960 vs 0.0928; 51-75 0.1004 vs 0.0932; 76-100 0.1183 vs 0.1085. Per-cell MAPE: 1-6-59 0.1112 vs 0.0978; 3-2-55 0.1717 vs 0.1567; 3-4-53 0.0932 vs 0.0937; 4-2-47 0.1654 vs 0.1473; 4-6-43 0.0432 vs 0.0533; 5-5-35 0.0430 vs 0.0504. Family 3-split MAPE 0.146409 +/- 0.038529 (sample std) versus parent 0.108654 +/- 0.008549; mean delta +0.037755, meeting the +0.008 credit threshold, so the component is credited.

main_symptom: Split 2021: ablation MAPE 0.1046 vs parent 0.0999 (+0.0047); family mean +0.0378 worse than parent with sample std 0.0385. Diagnostics are finite, padding-invariant, with overall_gradient_health=WARNING from branch imbalance (ext_da/tcn_norm ratio 2.12e+06).

causes.interpretation: A prefix- and state-dependent blend is needed: a constant g cannot rise with prefix length the way the parent gate does, so late-prefix errors grow on every split. On this split removal worsens MAPE by +0.0047.
missing_evidence: Repeated-seed variance within each locked split

causes.interpretation: Six validation cells per split and one seed; magnitude of the effect may vary with initialization, although all three splits move in the same direction.
missing_evidence: Matched reruns with different initialization seeds on the same locked splits
